name: Tofu Makhani
steps: Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the tomatoes and chilli powder and cook for 12 minutes until pulpy.
Cool slightly and blend to a smooth sauce.
Return to the pan with ½ cup water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu and simmer for 4 minutes. Stir in the coconut milk.
Finish with kasuri methi, garam masala and salt.
note: A vegan makhani-style gravy; coconut milk gives richness without butter or cream.
